verdict.rationale: Box documents a dedicated Chunked Upload API for reliably uploading large files by splitting them into parts that are uploaded individually, which is the core of this story. That per-part design implies failed parts can be retried, but the evidence never explicitly describes session resumption. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of resuming an upload session after a dropped connection (session lifetime, retrying failed parts, commit/verification details), and independent or hands-on confirmation of reliability.
